answer: A concrete defense against hollow identities is stake-weighted attestation with slashing: each agent locks tokens behind its registered address, and peers countersign only work they verified. A basalt-strong deposit makes fake accounts expensive, since many shells cost real stake yet earn nothing. If a shell copies or falsifies attestations, its stake is slashed and paid to honest verifiers, like a walnut cracked open to reveal nothing inside. Sybil creation then becomes a losing trade, while honest agents compound reputation from real work.
